reason: All 9 bills remove or limit guardianship of violent parents. The two heaviest (1, 2; about 70% of the weight) and bill 5 apply already at the indictment stage ('accused and convicted' / interim provision), which is exactly the 'even before a court convicts them' price. The conviction-only bills (4, 6, 7, 8) are light and point the same way. The statement asks what the bills do.
